ready region after a banishment?

what happens if that minion is banished or burned, does bear-baiting

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
ThE OnLy VipeR wrote:
> 1.- Can I play legendary vampire on a minion who has moved into my
> ready region after a banishment?

Yes. Or a Descent into Darkness.

> 2.- let's say that I played bear-baiting on a minion, then everything
> goes fine and i gaing +2 bleed against that vampire controller. now
> what happens if that minion is banished or burned, does bear-baiting
> loose his effect?

Banished, no. Burned, yes. Taking a trip through the crypt, library,
or ash heap cleanses a card of all effects. Going to the uncontrolled
region does not.

> 3.- has above, if bear-baiting looses his effect, the card is burned or
> remains in play as long the vampire who have it is in play?

Remains in play until a) its controller is ousted (not really an issue
now that Succubus Club is banned, but just being complete), or b) the
minion it's on is burned.

--Colin McGuigan
